purpose: Bounded preview verification after separating infantry, miner and fort protection responsibilities

decision.budget: 32 ordinary full games, one case per map/opponent/policy cell, 16 per defender. Same four opponents, maps and evaluator for both. This is a bounded preview check, with limited start/execution-slot coverage, not confirmation of strength or default promotion. Preserve all failures/caps. The maintained default stays 0.1.12 because earlier expanded candidates regressed; the preview and original pressure specialist get separate playable entries.
